Excellent! All 213 tests pass. The overdue report feature is complete:

- `overdueInvoices(invoices, asOf)` returns `ok([{number, customerId, dueDate, daysOverdue, due}])`
- Filters to issued/partially_paid invoices with dueDate before asOf
- Calculates daysOverdue using daysBetween (asOf - dueDate)
- Calculates due amount from balanceDue for each invoice
- Sorted by daysOverdue descending (most overdue first)
- Validates asOf date, returns DATE_INVALID if invalid
- Comprehensive test coverage including edge cases
